prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: 两列长文 · 方案对比 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 3 columns × 4 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "维度" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 2: header "方案 A：自建集群" · longest unbreakable word 47px · one-line width 557px
  col 3: header "方案 B：托管服务" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 552px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"比较自建集群与托管服务在成本、运维和合规等维度上的取舍，帮助读者选择方案。","reading":"读者先定位左侧维度，再横向比较同一行的两种方案；行内长文可换行，但两方案应保持清晰对应。","groups":["方案 A 与方案 B 是并列的比较对象，承担相同的信息角色，通常应获得相近的宽度。","维度列提供各行的索引，内容较短，需要与右侧两列保持明确区分。"],"keep_intact":["成本、运维、合规等短维度名称宜保持单行。","方案名称、数字和其他不可拆分的词应尽量保持完整。"],"may_wrap":["两种方案的说明文字可自然换行；同一行较长的说明形成的高度可供另一侧文字换行使用。","方案列标题可在自然位置换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r0A: widths [52, 153, 154] · table 360×355px · row heights [36, 129, 106, 83] · column headers wrapped 0/3 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0B: widths [38, 160, 161] · table 360×379px · row heights [60, 129, 106, 83] · column headers wrapped 1/3 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 0
Design r0C: widths [52, 175, 132] · table 360×379px · row heights [60, 153, 83, 83] · column headers wrapped 1/3 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r0A","good":"维度名称和两个方案标题均保持单行；方案列宽度几乎相等，便于逐行横向比较。三行数据的边界清楚，文字分布也较均衡。","problems":"成本行较高，右侧部分短句末尾留下少量空白；合规行两侧的换行位置也不完全协调。","cause":"维度列为52px，刚好容纳两个汉字；两方案列各约153px，长文需换成多行。"},{"design":"r0B","good":"两方案列仍然等宽，正文可读，且没有词语被强行拆开。","problems":"维度标题及三个维度名称均竖向折成两行，削弱了左侧索引的扫读作用；表头也因此增高。正文行高与r0A相同，增加的方案列宽度没有带来明显收益。","cause":"维度列缩至38px，扣除21px边距和边框后仅剩17px，容不下两个汉字；释放的宽度分配给方案列后，未改变正文行数。"},{"design":"r0C","good":"较宽的方案A列使运维和合规说明更紧凑，左侧维度名称也保持单行。","problems":"方案B标题折行，成本说明增至六行并出现很短的末行；两方案列比例失衡，削弱并列比较的视觉关系。成本行增高，抵消了其他行变紧凑的收益。","cause":"方案A列增至175px，方案B列相应缩至132px；后者扣除边距和边框后，标题及长文的可用宽度不足。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"A略宽","widths":[52,158,149],"change":"保留可单行显示维度名称的宽度，将5px从方案B移给方案A，检验能否改善方案A的换行，同时保持两个标题单行和方案列的近似平衡。"},{"name":"B略宽","widths":[52,148,159],"change":"将5px从方案A移给方案B，检验能否改善方案B成本行的换行，同时保持两个标题单行和并列比较的视觉平衡。"}]}
